items.label: WHD civil: Gate Solution Systems Inc. and Healthcare Services Group Inc.
items.detail: Consent judgment in the District of Massachusetts (1:24-cv-12803-PBS, Doc. 6, entered 2024-11-25) over misclassifying housekeeping, laundry and dietary workers as contractors and unpaid overtime; date is the DOL release date (release: https://www.dol.gov/newsroom/releases/whd/whd20241203-0). This row is Healthcare Services Group's own obligation: it alone owes $495,000 in back wages plus $495,000 in liquidated damages (paragraphs 4 and 8), interest not counted. Gate Solution Systems' obligation, shared with three individuals, is row :2. | Counted at this defendant's stated share, $990,000 of a $2,425,576.10 total (data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).

items.label: WHD civil: Gate Solution Systems Inc. and Healthcare Services Group Inc.
items.detail: Same consent judgment. Gate Solution Systems and three natural persons owe $717,788.05 in back wages plus $717,788.05 in liquidated damages, plus interest, jointly and severally (paragraphs 3 and 4); the judgment does not divide it between the company and the individuals, so it is a shared total. A Satisfaction of Judgment was filed 2026-02-19. The release's 'over $2.4 million' for two companies folds the individuals' joint obligation into the companies. | Not counted in the total. Shared total, split not stated by the source: counted for no company, kept in gross (overlap group shared-whd-2024-gate-gss; listed under Amounts not counted).

excluded_amounts.defendant: Gate Solution Systems Inc. and Healthcare Services Group Inc.
excluded_amounts.reason: Shared total, split not stated: Consent judgment paragraphs 3 and 4: Gate Solution Systems and three natural persons owe $717,788.05 back wages plus $717,788.05 liquidated damages jointly and severally; the judgment does not divide it between the company and the individuals. Satisfaction of Judgment was filed 19 Feb 2026 (docket entry 7). The DOL release's 'over $2.4 million for two companies' folds the individuals' joint obligation into the companies. Source (read 2026-10-11): "shall pay, jointly and severally, said back wages, liquidated damages, and interest". The primary document gives one total for payers that include anyone outside the company, so the total is counted for no company; the row stays in gross (overlap group shared-whd-2024-gate-gss; data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
